training_config.experiment: Paper 1 V7 selector-only, condition-aware compatibility experiment
training_config.initialization: V4 best for all frozen modules; new selector initialized with seed 42
training_config.candidate_generator: unchanged V4 candidate-specific residual branches; frozen for V7
training_config.selector: shared candidate encoder + condition projection + elementwise candidate-condition interaction; candidate preservation score and consequence error as utility inputs
training_config.target: For each image rank its three candidates separately on reference L1, preservation distortion, and consequence L1; ties receive average rank; average the three normalized ranks (0 best, 1 worst); argmin is the target. No class quotas or train-global scales.

target_training_only_audit.target_formula: For each training image, rank the three V4-best candidates separately by reference L1, preservation distortion, and consequence L1. Lower is better; ties share average rank. Divide each rank by 2, average the three dimensions with equal 1/3 weight, and select the minimum mean-rank candidate. Targets are not forced or balanced.
target_training_only_audit.targeting_note: This is a training-only descriptive audit on V4 candidate metrics from the existing Phase A cache. Validation Pareto results were not used to choose target formula or class frequencies.

training_config.preprocessing: paired RGB ToTensor [0,1]; paired random horizontal flip train only
training_config.selector_tradeoff_losses: Expected reference L1, preservation distortion, and consequence errors under selector probabilities; makes all three existing terms directly train the selector.
